payload.title: A sensor's placement cannot be changed after registration: no page calls updateSensorInfo's unchecked placement fields and the device page's edit link goes to a route that does not exist, so a sensor registered at a site can never be bound to a tank
evidence: web/modules/sensor-module/src/hooks/useSensorRegistration.ts:412-425 (updateInfo is defined but no component calls it)
web/modules/sensor-module/src/pages/DeviceDetailPage.tsx:420-426 (Düzenle links to /sensor/devices/:id/edit; web/modules/sensor-module/src/Module.tsx:99-103 has no such route)
apps/farm-service/src/water-quality/services/channel-placement.ts:54-77 (a channel stands at a tank only when its sensor names that tank)
payload.rule_violated: Product request (Okan 2026-10-30): an MQTT sensor's pH and temperature are bound to the tanks and systems they measure on /sites/water-chemistry and /sensor/water-chemistry
payload.notes: Found on 2026-10-30 when the production tenant's only sensor (site-level, five channels reporting) could not be bound to a tank.
